{{Top|leg}}
A '''Corellian flame sculpture''' was a type of sculpture. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a stolen Corellian flame sculpture worth 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was taken to a hotel room in the [[Starlight Lounge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] by the minions of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]].
